stored_values.coverage: Dataset records verified by native browse fields; manual capacity rules and implementation snapshot/capacity tests additionally covered without claiming live hidden-digit parity.

sources.scope: STAT submode menu, SD and paired data, separators, field/whole-record corrections, signed/fractional and zero frequency, deletion, power persistence, CA and malformed-pair error.
Statistics data entry/correction, 100-slot capacity accounting, Error 3; general numerical range in calculation ranges.

notes: Native frequency label is Nn=, not Fn=; seven submodes expose no three-variable STAT.
Zero frequency omits a new observation or deletes an existing record; signed and fractional frequencies are retained.
Native expressions show a blinking cursor after commas; comma text is transcribed without that cursor.

100 storage slots and Error 3 come from the full manual, not a live 101-record stress probe. Numeric range is the existing pinned manual range; private boundary digits remain a later cross-mode precision audit.
Native significant checkpoints are independent evidence; all intermediate golden frames are implementation regression assertions.
